project-oneliner: paste your rough project, get it back pitch-ready — name, one-liner, hero copy and a 2-minute pitch, rendered as a launch card that looks designed.
project-description: Every build night ends the same way: great builds that lose the room in the first sentence. Carretai fixes the part engineers skip — the story. Paste a messy description of what you built and get back a sharp name (with alternatives), a one-liner that passes the 'you get it in 5 seconds' test, homepage hero copy, and a timed 2-minute pitch outline — all rendered on a launch card with actual design taste, ready to keep and share. It also flags the generic AI-slop phrases in your copy ('revolutionary AI-powered platform') and rewrites them like a human. The name is the thesis: carreta (Colombian — echar carreta, to spin the story) + cachai (Chilean — you get it?). You spin the story, they get it. Built from zero at Build Night Bogotá with Claude Code, Next.js and Groq, by a designer who ships.
